exposure: Gestational age at birth (preterm vs. term)
cohort: Apparently healthy low birth weight newborns weighing 1500 to ≤2499 g
finding: The study found similar ranges and mean pre- and post-ductal SpO2 values for both preterm and term low birth weight neonates weighing 1500 g to <2500 g during the first 72 h of life.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery did not affect SpO2 values within 10-24 h of life.
